# What Preflight ports from modelcontextprotocol/registry, and the registry
# commit it was last checked against. This is the one place the pin lives.
# .github/registry-drift.sh compares each file at that commit with the
# registry's main, and checks each issue is still open. When one changes, read
# the change, update the port if it needs it, then move the commit here
# (the full 40-character SHA: GitHub fetches only those).
